text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from stopping by the 
shopping district with Mejiro Ardan to 
restock training supplies—
choice_data_list:
Thanks for keeping me company while 
shopping.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No. These are all things I'll be using, 
and you're busy as well, Trainer, so I'm 
happy to help out like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Is that—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my, a lottery raffle...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It has been quite a while since I last saw 
one in action...! That lottery wheel has 
such charming character, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly remember that the training gear 
I just bought came with a single lottery 
ticket.
choice_data_list: Wanna try the raffle?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However, wasn't that acquired with your 
own shopping, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Today's shopping is for Aldan as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. If you say so, I'd gladly take 
you up on that offer and give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Hey there, miss. Care to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan eagerly turned the lottery 
wheel's handle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: Nice going, Ardan!
You did it, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um... so... are 'Grand Prizes' something 
that comes up a lot?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, missy, what are you saying?! The 
'Grand Prize' is only the 'Grand Prize' 
precisely because it rarely ever comes 
out!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I apologize. I was so 
surprised, my mind just... went blank—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Still... Is it really all right for me to 
draw the "Special Grand Prize"...?
choice_data_list:
Must be good karma from your everyday 
actions.

It's probably good karma from how well you 
behave every day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... I am honored, yet 
truly humbled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Given that I have strove to etch myself 
into the 'now' with the spirit of defying 
destiny... I never imagined I would 
receive such a blessing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer, you mentioned earlier that I 
drew the ticket myself, but originally, it 
was still your raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So, could you... hold onto this ticket for 
me, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but this belongs to Aldan.
I don't mind, but this is Aldan's.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was the one who drew the prize with your 
ticket, Trainer. Therefore, I was thinking 
we should discuss how to use it 
together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the "me" of today is dedicating 
everything to racing. Sparing the time and 
focus for a trip would be rather 
difficult.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, all right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When the right time comes... let's discuss 
how we should use this travel voucher, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
First prize...!? To get this from a random 
lottery draw, something like this is—
choice_data_list: Nice going, Ardan!
You did it, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Still, look at the sheer size of it. And 
it's not merely massive, but a masterwork 
showing such meticulous craftsmanship...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm really torn on how to eat this.
choice_data_list: I bet it'll be super delicious.
I'm sure it'll be delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. These Salisbury steaks... If 
you'd like, would you want to eat together 
after this?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When you think about it, those lottery 
tickets came from your shopping, Trainer. 
And yet you let me draw them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So to speak, this is a prize that the two 
of us won together. Therefore, it only 
stands to reason that we eat it together.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, maybe I'll join you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. By all means.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now that that is decided, shall we buy the 
ingredients for the sauce and side dishes 
here before heading back?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since this is such an exquisite delicacy, 
let us enjoy it in the absolute finest way 
possible right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Ardan and I thoroughly 
relished the deluxe carrot hamburg 
steak...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: We did it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. To be honest, I never expected to 
actually draw a winning prize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even so, this amount— While it does make 
me happy, it's far too much for me to 
handle alone.
choice_data_list:
Why not consider sharing some with your 
friends?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see...! That sounds like a very good 
idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Then, I'll take portions for Trainer who 
gave me the tickets and myself who drew 
them first, and share the rest with my 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Shall we cook something with our share of 
carrots later?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, what's the first dish that 
comes to mind when you think of carrots?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while eating the carrot dishes 
Mejiro Ardan made, we recharged our energy 
for tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, correct.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What a gorgeous carrot. I can tell it was 
grown with great care. It looks delicious 
enough to eat raw—
choice_data_list: Then, do you want to try eating it now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't this a bit improper?
choice_data_list:
It's pretty much just street food, so 
don't worry about it.

It's pretty much just street food, so 
don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Is that how it is? Even so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I can't deny that I'm interested.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Since it's a special occasion, 
would you like to join us, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Ardan and I split a 
carrot in half and ate it as we walked 
home.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh. A miss, was it...?
choice_data_list: That was unfortunate...
That was unfortunate...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Now that it actually missed... It's 
surprisingly disheartening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It seems a lottery naturally builds up 
that much anticipation before you even 
draw. It was a good experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for letting me draw. I was 
hoping to win something so I could share 
it with you, Trainer, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry I couldn't make it take shape.
choice_data_list: Oh, there's no need to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we head back?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she didn't show it overtly in her 
words or actions, I somehow knew that 
Mejiro Ardan was feeling a little down...
